head: MyPitStop tracks car maintenance for up to seven vehicles
dek: MyPitStop keeps up to seven cars in a garage list, with mileage and one maintenance list for oil changes, fluids, checks and your own tasks. It was #79 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
means: If you forget when the last oil change was, this keeps the record.
todo: Find MyPitStop in the App Store.
